gloss: opening goal; first point; first score

definitions.gloss: opening goal; first point; first score
definitions.explanation: the first point or goal scored in a game, giving the scoring team an early lead

examples.japanese: {先取点|せんしゅてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧{十分|じっぷん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先取点|せんしゅてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}った→奪う：01895_ubau⟧。
examples.english: They seized the first goal ten minutes into the first half.

examples.japanese: {先取点|せんしゅてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}して→許す：02325_yurusu⟧しまった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They gave up the opening goal but came back to win in the second half.

notes:
A key term in sports commentary. The first goal or point of a match is significant in Japanese sports culture, as it sets the psychological tone. Composed of {先取|せんしゅ} (taking first) and ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先取点|せんしゅてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to score the first point
- {先取点|せんしゅてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧: to seize the first goal
- {先取点|せんしゅてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: to concede the first goal
- {先取点|せんしゅてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to notch the opening goal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先制点|せんせいてん}→先制点：08585_senseiten⟧: preemptive score — essentially the same meaning, equally common
- {追加点|ついかてん}: additional score — a subsequent goal that extends the lead
- ⟦{同点|どうてん}→同点：08586_douten⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧: equalizing goal

REGISTER:
Neutral. Standard in sports news, commentary, and casual discussion of games.
